name: Release v0.35.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(server): stop a dropped capability listing from killing the client by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/301
* fix(client): forward structuredContent when a tool sends no text by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/309
* fix(streaming): stop a failed chunk from silently emptying the response by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/310
* chore(deps): bump any-llm-sdk to 1.27.2 by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/312
* fix: tool calls and stream errors against cloud providers by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/313
* chore(deps): bump typer from 0.27.1 to 0.27.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/308
* docs: add logging information for ollmcp in README files by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/315
* fix(streaming): close the response stream when a silent run is aborted by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/316
* fix(streaming): don't print the thinking header for whitespace-only reasoning by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/317
* feat: add /new command and group alternate command names in autocomplete by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/318
* chore(release): bump version to 0.35.0 by @jonigl in https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/pull/319


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jonigl/mcp-client-for-ollama/compare/v0.34.0...v0.35.0

### Credit

This release came almost entirely from user reports 🙏

Thanks to @EzequielEnrique, whose ruling out led to the tool naming and in-stream error fixes, to @razed-developer and @w1977-0 for the `structuredContent` half, and to @MaarVFX for sticking with the Unreal MCP connection bug until it was fixed 🙌

And a special one to @skweeker, who runs all of this on an 8 GB Raspberry Pi 5 🫶 Small hardware finds bugs and helps make local tooling better for everyone: he followed this one through the Ollama logs down to the exact line that sets the context size, and thanks to @kartsan03 the fix is now heading upstream into any-llm itself 🙌
